name: drazenrubin-poa-tool-backend
description: Power of Attorney document assembly backend for Drazen Rubin Law — Express + docxtemplater.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join(__dirname,'..','frontend'),dst=path.join(__dirname,'public');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Frontend copied to backend/public');}else{console.log('No ../frontend found, skipping.');}"
